=== Standalone upgrades

- Fixed an issue where upgrading a Standalone server to 4.27.0S could fail after the required mid-upgrade reboot. Depending on timing, the upgrade either stopped while waiting for services to shut down, or finished the data migration but left some platform services unable to start. In the second case, the remaining services could not deploy until the stuck services were restarted manually. The upgrade now completes in a single run.

_Applies to Standalone servers upgrading from a 4.26 release to 4.27.0S._
